summary.name: Highlights
summary.one_liner: Highlights is a PDF reader and annotation app for Mac, iPad and iPhone that turns PDF annotations into notes and exports them to formats such as Markdown, HTML and PDF.
use_cases: Exporting PDF highlights and notes to Markdown or HTML
Looking up DOIs and metadata for cited articles
Extracting text from scanned PDFs with OCR
Copying tables from PDFs into a spreadsheet
Continuing PDF reading across Mac, iPad and iPhone
summary.what_it_does: Highlights lets users read and annotate PDFs on Mac, iPad and iPhone, with tools placed for quick access and optional Apple Pencil gestures to switch tools. It extracts annotations, images, tables and citations and can export them as Markdown, TextBundle, HTML, WebArchive or PDF. Citations can be marked up and looked up to find DOIs and download metadata, and already-read citations are linked to the PDF on the device. Built-in OCR extracts text from PDFs without searchable text, and processing runs on device. Smart Copy formats annotations when copied, including converting recognized tables for pasting into spreadsheets.
notable: Exports annotations as Markdown, TextBundle, HTML, WebArchive and PDF
Citation lookup finds DOIs and metadata and links to already-read PDFs
On-device multilingual OCR and table recognition
Stores annotations as standard PDF annotations, so files are not locked in
caveats: Platform support is limited to Apple devices (Mac, iPad, iPhone) per the page
Sync of files depends on external services such as iCloud Drive or Dropbox
